rule_yaml:
rules:
  - id: dubbo-npe-c1-taint-nullable-value-dereference
    languages:
      - java
    mode: taint
    severity: WARNING
    message: >-
      A value that can be null is dereferenced here without a null guard. In this Dubbo NPE
      cluster the nullable origins are: metadata / service lookups (getServiceInfo(),
      getValidServiceInfo()), attachment getters (getObjectAttachmentWithoutConvert(),
      getObjectAttachment(), getAttachment()), credentials taken from a possibly truncated
      user:password@ URL segment (getUsername(), getPassword()), and the URL internal
      urlAddress holder (null for URLs built through the no-arg constructor / URLBuilder /
      ServiceConfigURL paths). The upstream fixes all bind the value to a local and guard it
      before use, e.g. if (x == null) { return default; }, x != null, x == null ? a : b, or
      Objects.requireNonNull(x), and fall back to a safe default such as an empty map or
      URLParam.parse(new HashMap<>()). Add such a guard before calling $SINK.$METHOD(...).
    metadata:
      category: correctness
      confidence: MEDIUM
      technology:
        - dubbo
      cwe:
        - 'CWE-476: NULL Pointer Dereference'
      references:
        - https://github.com/apache/dubbo/pull/10306
        - https://github.com/apache/dubbo/pull/10921
        - https://github.com/apache/dubbo/pull/13631
        - https://github.com/apache/dubbo/pull/16299
    pattern-sources:
      # Nullable metadata / registry service-info lookups. getValidServiceInfo() returns null
      # when the metadata has no service info for the given protocolServiceKey, and
      # InstanceAddressURL#getServiceInfo(...) can return null too. Bare (implicit-this) calls
      # are included because the buggy code calls them unqualified.
      - pattern-either:
          - pattern: $X.getServiceInfo(...)
          - pattern: getServiceInfo(...)
          - pattern: $X.getValidServiceInfo(...)
          - pattern: getValidServiceInfo(...)
      # Nullable attachment getters: null when the key is absent or when the invocation
      # metadata failed to deserialize (the misleading-NPE-of-path case).
      - pattern-either:
          - pattern: $X.getObjectAttachmentWithoutConvert(...)
          - pattern: getObjectAttachmentWithoutConvert(...)
          - pattern: $X.getObjectAttachment(...)
          - pattern: getObjectAttachment(...)
          - pattern: $X.getAttachment(...)
          - pattern: getAttachment(...)
      # Credentials that may be missing because of a truncated 'user:password@' segment
      # (e.g. a password containing '#' cut the authority part of the URL string).
      - pattern-either:
          - pattern: $X.getUsername()
          - pattern: getUsername()
          - pattern: $X.getPassword()
          - pattern: getPassword()
      # The URL internal address holder: null for URLs created through the no-arg /
      # URLBuilder / ServiceConfigURL paths, then dereferenced by setProtocol/setHost/getIp/...
      - pattern-either:
          - pattern: urlAddress
          - pattern: this.urlAddress
    pattern-sinks:
      # Dereference of the tainted value: calling any method on it (addParameter(),
      # addParameterIfAbsent(), addConsumerParams(), getAllParams(), getNumbers(),
      # getMethodNumbers(), equals(), setProtocol(), setUsername(), setPassword(), setHost(),
      # setPort(), setAddress(), setPath(), getAddress(), getIp(), ...).
      - patterns:
          - pattern: $SINK.$METHOD(...)
          # guard forms that contain the dereference: the checked value is never null here
          - pattern-not-inside: |
              if ($SINK == null) { ... }
          - pattern-not-inside: |
              if (null == $SINK) { ... }
          - pattern-not-inside: |
              if ($SINK != null) { ... }
          - pattern-not-inside: |
              if (null != $SINK) { ... }
          - pattern-not-inside: |
              if ($SINK == null) { ... } else { ... }
          - pattern-not-inside: |
              if (null == $SINK) { ... } else { ... }
          - pattern-not-inside: |
              if ($SINK != null) { ... } else { ... }
          - pattern-not-inside: |
              if (null != $SINK) { ... } else { ... }
          - pattern-not-inside: |
              $SINK == null ? $A : $B
          - pattern-not-inside: |
              null == $SINK ? $A : $B
    pattern-sanitizers:
      # early-return / early-throw guards
      - pattern-either:
          - pattern: |
              if ($X == null) { return ...; }
          - pattern: |
              if (null == $X) { return ...; }
          - pattern: |
              if ($X == null) { return; }
          - pattern: |
              if (null == $X) { return; }
          - pattern: |
              if ($X == null) { throw ...; }
          - pattern: |
              if (null == $X) { throw ...; }
      # positive guards
      - pattern-either:
          - pattern: |
              if ($X != null) { ... }
          - pattern: |
              if (null != $X) { ... }
          - pattern: |
              if ($X == null) { ... } else { ... }
          - pattern: |
              if (null == $X) { ... } else { ... }
      # ternary guards / default values
      - pattern-either:
          - pattern: |
              $X == null ? $A : $B
          - pattern: |
              null == $X ? $A : $B
          - pattern: |
              $X != null ? $A : $B
          - pattern: |
              null != $X ? $A : $B
      # explicit non-null assertions
      - pattern-either:
          - pattern: $OBJ.requireNonNull($X)
          - pattern: java.util.Objects.requireNonNull($X)
          - pattern: java.util.Objects.nonNull($X)
          - pattern: org.apache.commons.lang3.Validate.notNull($X)
message: Nullable value dereferenced without a null guard (Dubbo NPE cluster: getServiceInfo()/getValidServiceInfo(), attachment getters like getObjectAttachmentWithoutConvert(), credentials parsed from a truncated user:password@ segment, and the URL internal urlAddress field). The upstream fixes all bind the value to a local, guard it (if (x == null) return/throw, x != null, x == null ? a : b, Objects.requireNonNull(x)) or fall back to a safe default (empty map / URLParam.parse(new HashMap<>())) before dereferencing. Add such a guard here.
commonality: The whole cluster is one defect shape: a value that is legitimately nullable in Dubbo (a MetadataInfo.ServiceInfo returned by getServiceInfo()/getValidServiceInfo(), an attachment returned by getObjectAttachmentWithoutConvert()/getAttachment(), the username/password parsed out of a possibly truncated 'user:password@' URL authority, or the URL internal urlAddress holder created by no-arg / URLBuilder / ServiceConfigURL paths) is used directly as a method receiver. The buggy versions chain the nullable origin straight into the dereference (getServiceInfo(k).addParameter(...), urlAddress.setProtocol(...), getValidServiceInfo(k).equals(...), url.getParameter(k).equals(...)); every fix in the cluster introduces the same null-guard idiom - assign to a local, then if (x == null) return/throw a default, x != null, a ternary, or an empty-map default - before the dereference. So it is a taint/data-flow problem (nullable origin -> dereference) rather than a structural one, and sanitizers are exactly the guard forms the patches add.
